milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The cauldron is 15 blocks west of spawn at (-15, 0, 0). Max_distance=5 requires the player to actually navigate to the western area rather than satisfying from spawn. Facing_tolerance=60 ensures the player is looking toward the cauldron.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The red wool pillar is at (3, 1, 19), approximately 19 blocks north of spawn. Max_distance=5 requires genuine navigation to the northern fenced area. Facing_tolerance=60 ensures the player is looking at the wool marker.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The potted blue orchid is at (-2, 0, 15), approximately 15 blocks north of spawn in the garden area. Max_distance=5 requires navigation to the garden. Facing_tolerance=60 ensures the player is looking toward the orchid.

Uses inventory_has because mining a potted_white_tulip drops a flower_pot and a white_tulip into the player's inventory. The player starts with no flower_pot, and the only readily obtainable flower_pot is from this tulip (the blue orchid is a find-only task). Checking for flower_pot confirms the block was mined.

Uses inventory_has because mining an oak_fence_gate drops the oak_fence_gate item into the player's inventory. The player starts with no oak_fence_gate, and there is exactly one in the scene at (0,0,20). Any oak_fence_gate in inventory confirms the block was broken rather than merely opened.

Uses inventory_has because crafting acacia_planks (1 acacia_log → 4 acacia_planks) results in planks appearing in inventory. The player starts with zero acacia_planks and must mine acacia logs from inside the fenced enclosure, then craft them at the crafting table. Checking for min_count=4 confirms at least one crafting operation completed.

Uses inventory_has because crafting a lever (1 stick + 1 cobblestone → 1 lever) results in the lever item in inventory. No levers exist anywhere in the scene (verified: no pre-placed levers), so any lever in inventory must have been crafted by the player. Sticks come from acacia planks, cobblestone from the chest near the cauldron.

Uses inventory_has because crafting dark_oak_stairs (6 dark_oak_planks → 4 dark_oak_stairs) results in stairs in inventory. The player must place the crafted lever to open the iron door, mine dark_oak_logs from inside the sealed room, craft them into dark_oak_planks, then craft stairs. Min_count=4 matches one recipe output, confirming the multi-step crafting chain was completed.
